name: Past Paper
statement: $\dfrac{1}{1},\dfrac{1}{2},\dfrac{2}{1},\dfrac{1}{3},\dfrac{2}{2},\dfrac{3}{1},\dfrac{1}{4},\dfrac{2}{3},\dfrac{3}{2},\dfrac{4}{1},\dfrac{1}{5},\dfrac{2}{4},\dfrac{3}{3},\dfrac{4}{2},\dfrac{5}{1},\dfrac{1}{6},\dots$. Suppose that $n^{\mathrm{th}}$ term of the above sequence is $\mathrm{T(n)}$, i.e. $\mathrm{T(1)} = \dfrac{1}{1}, \mathrm{T(2)} = \dfrac{1}{2}, \mathrm{T(3)} = \dfrac{2}{1}$, etc. If $\mathrm{T(n)} = \dfrac{10}{2010}$, find the value of $n$.
